item.title: AmbuSens IoT based Ubiquitous Healthcare Monitoring
item.description: The AmbuSens system was developed at the Smart Wireless Applications and Networking (SWAN) Lab at the Indian Institute of Technology, Kharagpur, India. AmbuSens focuses on achieving seamless real-time monitoring and management of healthcare data in an ambulatory context, leveraging IoT technologies such as wireless on-body sensors, cellular (3G/4G), and cloud computing. The system leverages wireless body area network (WBAN) to wirelessly collect various physiological health parameters (e.g., ECG and heart rate).
